messages:
Marta: Need quick approval — Contrail Systems requests a 60-day Dedicated pilot, procurement requires an invoice, asking 26% off list. PO incoming.
Caleb: Can you drop the $ math?
Marta: List = $45,000/mo. At 26% off that's $33,300/mo => $66,600 total. PO has no commit.
Tanya: Policy reminder: discounts >20% need RevOps + CFO sign-off. Also request billing tag "pilot_contrail" for reporting.
Marta: LegalBot — please confirm SOW addendum language we need if finance signs off.
LegalBot: Will prepare a 60-day pilot addendum: term limit, conversion requires separate agreement, basic data handling clause and limited liability.
BillingBot: billing-bot created draft invoice INV-2026-0999 for $33,300/month (draft). Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0999
Caleb: Margin is tight at 26% if usage spikes. Recommend a hard token cap (suggest 175k tokens/day) or auto-reprice clause beyond cap. Can AE get that into the PO amendment?
Marta: AE says procurement prefers plain invoice but may accept a short cap clause. I'm pushing for the amendment now.
CFO_Raj: I can approve up to 20% for a 60-day pilot provided: 1) token cap or auto-reprice, 2) SOW addendum signed, 3) invoice tagged for analytics. For 26% I need an exec-level exception — Marta, escalate with ACV conversion thesis and regional priority.
RevOpsBot: Tagging thread as deal-desk-exception; will track approvals and reconciliation cadence.
Marta: Escalating to Execs now and will attach PO amendment when available. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
